method.retention: Only exact full raw text and status identity permits copying the preceding case judgment unchanged.
method.semantics: Full sentence context and numerical value/unit/relation, negation and entity identity considered separately from orthography; not WER-only or exact-string scoring.

limitations: Already exposed acceptance cases; no new blind-heldout claim.
Published reference comparison; no independent audio/label certification or invented hearing-before-ASR gate.
Existing name spelling/entity failures and numerical uncertainty remain reported; no invented general zero-name-error threshold.
Local lexical errors and punctuation do not establish a new pipeline segmentation fault.
Old severe-noise constructed 300s case is outside clean75/158; numerical quality retained separately, no whole-content pass.

Diagnostic native-timestamp mode only; initialization in developer main and temporary observation allocations differ from ordinary worker initialization. No resource/L comparison or product-default change.
Inherited parameterChangesFromAcceptanceV1 text is not the complete candidate delta: explicit runtime.no_timestamps=false and parameterChangeFromAcceptanceV2 identify the additional timestamp change.
Every bound raw file and historical review retained unchanged.
